notes.title: Some online features have been discontinued.
notes.content: [p]We sincerely apologize, but we have come to the decision that it is better to discontinue the online chat feature due to our lack of technical capability. In the future, we plan to set up a lobby to enhance offline play and accommodate multiple maps. Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]Other players in the lobby will be displayed. Other players will appear on the regular map as well, but no chat can be used.[/p]

notes.content: マップの更新をしました！

notes.title: Volumetric Clouds - Supported flowing clouds!
notes.content: [p]We have also added support for Volumetric Clouds - flowing clouds, a feature of Unity HDRP![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583235/32727139b2345ebd3703b667b19352f93f0dd8d3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We've added support for RTX ON/OFF!
notes.content: [p]It is currently in trial operation, but it now supports RTX ON/OFF! After setting it, you need to restart the game.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583235/453039e093dca5fcdbbe0dfb33077478f4625adc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DLSS/FSR 2.0 has been enabled by default!
notes.content: Due to the low FPS, DLSS/FSR 2.0 has been enabled by default!

notes.title: Fixed the bug.
notes.content: [p]Fixed the bug that made the screen bright with a left click, and created an SF base![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583235/f0db75a7cfb4c9665ca8b7f5af1e3b82e8e89a54.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We have migrated the rendering pipeline from URP to HDRP!
notes.content: [p]We have migrated the rendering pipeline from URP to HDRP!The game stage has been significantly changed, but we will continue to improve it.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583235/087b26cd043c8ca7175fca34fb0158a297bac6e7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.content: [p]I aligned the orientation of the faces so that the players do not get stuck on the buildings![/p]
